_comment: The publishable build (REA-223). tsconfig.json is the editor/typecheck config and stays noEmit; this one emits plain ESM JavaScript into dist/ because Node refuses to strip types for anything installed under node_modules (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING, verified against Node 22.23.2 with a real `npm i -g` of the raw-.ts tarball), so a package whose bin is a .ts file looks installable and is not. rewriteRelativeImportExtensions turns this source's ./cli.ts specifiers into ./cli.js in the output; the shebang on bin/realuptime.ts is preserved by tsc.
